pages.text: Today, eggs would go to market. Many had gathered in the henhouse.
Eggs broke with a little knock. "I will carry them to the cart without breaking one." Pipo held an empty basket.
Mr. Horse stamped beside the cart. "We will be late! Quick, quick, fill it!"
He grabbed many eggs with his big hand. Eggs poked between his fingers.
Crack! One broke in his hand. Yolk ran down.
"Oh dear!" Startled, he opened his hand. Another crack, then another.
His hands were covered in yolk. He stood hesitating, hands raised.
Pipo lined the basket with soft hay. He nestled eggs in it one by one.
Hugging the basket firmly with both arms, he walked softly. The eggs stayed still in the hay.
The egg basket reached the cart safely. Mr. Horse washed his hands at the well. Yolk had even reached his mane.
